name: svn-mcp
description: Self-sufficient, read-only SVN access — runs the `svn` CLI directly. Exposes an MCP (stdio) interface for AI-driven callers and a small persistent HTTP bridge (dist/http-server.js) for other services (e.g. claudeweb) to depend on.

scripts.build:exe: npm run bundle:edit && pkg dist/svn-edit.bundle.cjs --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist-exe/svn-edit.exe
